# oxide_system_ip_pool (Data Source)

Retrieve information about a specified system IP pool.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "oxide_system_ip_pool" "example" {
  pool = "my-pool"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `pool` (String) Name or ID of the IP pool.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `assignment` (String) What this pool is currently assigned to.
- `description` (String) Human-readable free-form text about the IP pool.
- `id` (String) Unique, immutable, system-controlled identifier for the IP pool.
- `ip_version` (String) The IP version for the pool.
- `name` (String) Unique, mutable, user-controlled identifier for the IP pool.
- `pool_type` (String) Type of IP pool (unicast or multicast).
- `time_created` (String) Timestamp when this IP pool was created.
- `time_modified` (String) Timestamp when this IP pool was last modified.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
